name: Set up the Nox editor and engine through Mist
body:
Dean (2026-11-05): "we are going to need to fix the way we install and run all these scripts so that it's managed for us."

Replace engine/tools' bind, install and build-native scripts and the editor's setup.sh with one mist.json at the repository root:

- SDL3, SDL3_image and SDL3_ttf from the index, with cgltf and stb_image.
- penumbra-ui-engine (nox-proto) and penumbra-bridge (main) as git packages.
- lantern-native as a path package. Its own mist.json runs its CMake build over nyx, chaos and cosmos, and writes the NyxC and ChaosUiC bindings.

nox.json files name packages with @ sources, and `mist run` starts the editor, the game and the tests. Tracked on the Mist board as MIST-14 (fearless-hq projects/mist-package-manager/kanban).

comments.text: Done on Linux (cloud, 2026-11-06): mist install builds SDL3, SDL3_image, SDL3_ttf, cgltf, stb_image and lantern-native; mist run test passes 189 of 189; mist run editor opens the editor under Xvfb (no Vulkan driver there, so the viewport can't draw). Needs fearlessgamedev/mist-package-manager#9, nox-systems-language#21 and the mist-index SDL entries. Not yet run on macOS.
